handoffs.message: INC-001 complete: IncidentCase and Postmortem backbone objects fully implemented. 71/71 unit tests PASS, 55/55 smoke checks PASS. All 3 normalized lineage edges (incident_case.runtime_binding, postmortem.incident_case, evolution_decision.postmortem) are carried in both objects. IncidentCase carries deployment_stage, binding_id, deployment_plan_id, capital_pool_id, persona_capital_binding_id, artifact_id, artifact_version, runtime_id, trace_id. Postmortem propagates the same evidence refs. JSON schemas (incident_case.schema.json, postmortem.schema.json) validate both valid and invalid payloads. IncidentStore enforces referential integrity (Postmortem requires IncidentCase). Artifacts: services/incident/incident.py, services/incident/__init__.py, services/incident/incident_case.schema.json, services/incident/postmortem.schema.json, services/incident/contract.md.
